deviation_tier.support: "מדינת ישראל תעודד הקמת נציגויות דיפלומטיות כאמור"
deviation_tier.note: Principal subject: foreign relations and Jerusalem's status. None of the five values engaged.

direction.support: Concerns foreign states' representations, not citizens' rights, identity or courts.

final_vote_record.value: 2024-10-29 16:59; vote 41927 (third reading); 29-7-0; approved only this law
final_vote_record.support: Vote 41927, 'הצעת חוק-יסוד: ירושלים בירת ישראל (תיקון מס' 3)', item 2201428; second reading 41928 (16:58): 29-7-0.

deviations: web.archive.org refused HTTPS from this machine; the same captures were fetched over HTTP in raw (id_) mode. Text was extracted with macOS PDFKit; some digits and footnotes come out garbled or out of order.
fs.knesset.gov.il and the Knesset website redirect to a geo-block page, and Nevo returned 403. No Nevo copy and no live Knesset page was used.
Seq 111 and 114 had no gazette capture in the sheet. I used Internet Archive captures of the gazette PDFs that the permitted Wikisource page links (23_lsr_572953, 23_lsr_578523).

Explanatory notes: bill PDF paths came from the Knesset bill-document table mirrored at production.oknesset.org/pipelines/data/bills/kns_documentbill (the bills/ folder is not named in the sheet). Captures existed for seq 92, 103, 106 and 111 only; those for 95, 99, 114, 118, 122 and 127 returned 404.
The seq 106 explanatory notes quote a High Court judgment. That passage was not used; only the notes' own statement of purpose (cabinet delegation, Amidror committee) was used.

Coalition composition: the Knesset site was unreachable. Coalition factions were taken from the Knesset's member-position table (kns_persontoposition), as factions holding minister or deputy-minister posts on the vote date; no encyclopedia was used. Names came from members/kns_person. A coalition faction with no minister or deputy minister would be missed.

For the seq 99 alternative mechanism I read Wikisource revisions of another statute (Penal Law s.2, 17.8.2016) and the prior text of Basic Law: The Knesset s.21A and s.42C (revisions of 14.7.2016 and 15.2.2022).

Seq 118: the plenum-vote and vote-result tables hold no vote on the bill (item 2151572). The tally is from press (Arutz Sheva, inn.co.il/news/462353; ice.co.il 800870); the Knesset record was unreachable. First-reading dates for seq 111 and 118 were not found; both are bounded by the bills' publication dates in the gazette footnotes.

Web-search summaries mentioned a ynet tally of 67 for and 3 abstaining for a State Economy amendment. It matches vote 33084 (15.7.2020, Amendment No. 2), not seq 114 or 118; I did not open or use it. No page about a court case was opened.
